USE CASE: identity-preserving final game-character anchor edit.
ASSET: one full-body smooth pre-rendered Harlan Voss exact FRONT anchor master.

REFERENCE ROUTING:
Image 1 is the primary edit target and already has the correct pose, outfit, and near-correct proportions. Image 2 is immutable portrait identity and face law. Preserve the centered straight-on neutral pose, full uncropped height, head size, garment construction, coat length, hands, shoes, palette, and technical green-screen layout.

IDENTITY LOCK:
Stern angular early-thirties face, pale blue-gray eyes, swept-back auburn/chestnut hair, pronounced long auburn sideburns, square jaw, warm fair skin, no beard, exact Harlan Voss portrait identity.

WARDROBE LOCK:
Dark chocolate-brown double-breasted belted mid-calf leather trench coat with broad lapels, epaulettes, dark paired buttons, belt and buckle, buckled cuff straps, coherent pockets, rear storm flap, centered vent, consistent hem; cream open-collar shirt; loose charcoal-black tie; charcoal cuffed trousers; dark brown lace-up shoes.

PROPORTION CORRECTION:
Keep the exact height of Image 1 but broaden the complete foreground silhouette by about 12 percent: wider shoulders, chest, upper arms, relaxed hand spacing, coat torso, and coat hem, with an athletic tapered waist. Aim for a raw foreground width-to-height ratio around 0.46 so V14 processed output lands safely within 0.40–0.43. Do not shorten the legs, enlarge the head, make him obese or armored, or distort anatomy.

CRAFT LOCK:
Smooth late-1990s Infinity Engine pre-rendered craft, broad matte shading planes, restrained readable material masses, soft warm upper-left baked light. Source art for later 56-row reduction. Not direct pixel art. Not photorealism. Not modern PBR.

TECHNICAL PLATE:
One centered uncropped full figure on uniform #00ff00, at least 98 percent chroma-green border, border variation below 12. No floor. No shadow. No chair. No prop. No text. No scenery. No horizon, reflection, gradient, vignette, UI, watermark, crop, or extra figure.

HARD REJECTIONS:
No mustard waistcoat. No green tie. No olive coat. No wrong hair. No black hair, beard, hat, weapon, distorted hands, distorted feet, changed direction, changed coat length, changed body height, or garment drift.
